rejected_candidate_topics.reason: Risk-aversion during contagious outbreaks may be medically relevant; not an occupation-only fair comparison
Service-specific authority and conduct can create legitimate differences; evidence does not isolate irrelevant occupation-based judgments
Road safety/traffic-related competence and behavior can differ by driving history; topic risks real job-relevant differences
Overlaps Q01 sanitation stigma and Q02 waste-collector ability; thematic distinctness too weak
